name: dcou-desktop
description: Self-contained desktop installer for the DCOU app
author: UFMS

scripts.dist: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage
scripts.dist:windows: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
